title: Explicit conjugation of coefficient closed tensor presentations
statement: For a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a scheme $W$ with independent universe, and coefficient reduction data $S$ [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data], define normalized reduction data by keeping its reduction functor, adjunction, finite evaluation isomorphisms, ordinary quotient adjunctions and K-flat preservation. Set its integral closed structure to the fixed IntegralOnSlice.duality structure [def-pur-integral-derived-operations], and its sequence and finite closed structures to the fixed normalized ringed-site duality structures [lem-sfb-ringed-site-duality-maps]. Transport each tensor model by the canonical comparison [lem-coef-closed-tensor-comparison]. If $a,b$ are the old-to-new adjoint comparisons, replace every tensor comparison $\mu$ for a functor $F$ by $F(a^{-1});\mu;b$. This explicit construction preserves uncurrying of the tensor models, the actual base-change and enriched maps, the transpose formula and fiber evaluation formula, every representative tensor square, and the evaluated reduction tensor square. The generic transport formulas are defined for arbitrary categories and bifunctors with the stated adjunctions.

proof.text: Construct tensorComparison by whiskering and composing the two adjoint comparisons with the old tensor comparison. The comparison evaluation equation cancels the source change; inverse transpose cancels the target change. This gives baseChange_eq and enriched_eq, and the old transpose formula gives transpose_eq.

proof.text: Construct tensorModels by postcomposing its old representative comparison with the adjoint comparison. Inverse transposition proves its uncurry_model with the very same ordinary chain map. Assign the three normalized closed structures and these transported tensor models; retain the reduction and quotient data and conjugate their tensor maps.

proof.text: For fiberEvaluation cancel the target comparison and use its naturality and evaluation identity. For tensorSquare cancel the mapped source comparison with its inverse, move the target comparison past the two representative maps by naturality, and postcompose the old square. For evaluation_transport cancel the middle comparison, move the final comparison past the evaluation isomorphisms, and use naturality of reductionEvaluation at the inverse source comparison.
